Create dictionaries mapping each product ID to its corresponding parameter values.

mapping_explanation: Product_ID column maps to the index set P.
Profit_Per_Unit column maps to parameter P_i (objective coefficient).
Machine_A_Hours_Req column maps to parameter M_Ai.
Machine_B_Hours_Req column maps to parameter M_Bi.
Labor_Hours_Req column maps to parameter L_i.
Raw_Material_Units_Req column maps to parameter R_i.
Min_Production_Requirement column maps to parameter x_min_i (lower bound).
Max_Market_Demand column maps to parameter D_i (upper bound).
assumptions: All required columns are present and contain valid numeric data.
Product_IDs are unique and serve as valid dictionary keys.
Missing values are not expected in the dataset.
The mathematical model contract uses illustrative fixed coefficients; actual optimization will dynamically use values loaded from the CSV.

import pandas as pd

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('/var/folders/yl/x3_zrbc16q18h23q2t01c0lr0000gn/T/tmpsramx9ki.csv')

# Define index set
P = df['Product_ID'].tolist()

# Define parameters as dictionaries indexed by product ID
P_i = dict(zip(df['Product_ID'], df['Profit_Per_Unit']))
M_Ai = dict(zip(df['Product_ID'], df['Machine_A_Hours_Req']))
M_Bi = dict(zip(df['Product_ID'], df['Machine_B_Hours_Req']))
L_i = dict(zip(df['Product_ID'], df['Labor_Hours_Req']))
R_i = dict(zip(df['Product_ID'], df['Raw_Material_Units_Req']))
x_min_i = dict(zip(df['Product_ID'], df['Min_Production_Requirement'].astype(int)))
D_i = dict(zip(df['Product_ID'], df['Max_Market_Demand'].astype(int)))
